title: Workflow Model Policy Overlay v1
description: Operator-editable, validated JSON overlay that selects per-workflow / per-step model profiles. Missing file = library defaults; an invalid file blocks workflow execution (missing != invalid). Per-context inheritance (WS-OVERLAYS): a non-'default' context is honored; each context may declare an 'extends' parent and resolution walks context -> extends... -> default ('default' is the inheritance root). An overlay with no 'extends' parses and resolves byte-identically to v0.1.28/29 (additive back-compat).

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for this overlay (recorded in the run snapshot's overlay_id). Defaults to 'default'.

contexts.description: Per-context overlays. D-2: only the 'default' key is honored/validated this release; other keys are reserved (inert).

extends.description: Optional parent context this context inherits from (WS-OVERLAYS). Resolution walks context -> extends... -> default; the first level that defines a step/workflow value wins. The parent must be a declared context or the 'default' root; a missing parent or an 'extends' cycle is a hard validation error. The 'default' context is the inheritance root and may not declare 'extends'. Omit for a context that inherits directly from 'default'.

workflows.description: Per-workflow overrides keyed by workflow id (e.g. 'implementation').

steps.description: Per-step profile id, keyed by step label (e.g. 'implement'). The value is a built-in model-profile id valid for the step's effective harness.

default_harness.description: Optional per-workflow default harness override (v0.1.29 / D-3). When set, every step of this workflow defaults to this Layer-2 harness unless a per-step 'harnesses' entry or a CLI override wins. Omit for the catalog default (codex).

harnesses.description: Optional per-step harness override (v0.1.29 / D-3), keyed by step label. Each value is a Layer-2 harness; it beats 'default_harness' for that step.

layer2Harness.description: A Layer-2 worker harness. Only 'codex' and 'pi' are valid (LAW 1); 'claude'/'opencode' are not Layer-2 workers.
